title: Local-first AI acceptance fixture

paragraphs.original: Mercury keeps subscriptions and cached articles on the local device.
paragraphs.translated: Mercury 将订阅源和缓存文章保存在本地设备上。

paragraphs.original: AI actions run only after the reader explicitly starts them.
paragraphs.translated: AI 操作仅在读者明确启动后运行。

paragraphs.original: If a Provider fails, the original article must remain readable.
paragraphs.translated: 如果 Provider 失败，原始文章仍必须保持可读。

summary: Mercury is local-first, starts AI work explicitly, and preserves readable originals on failure.
